description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationDao class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to employee termination records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving termination records, retrieving a specific record by ID, and fetching a list of termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee termination records, providing methods to save, retrieve, and list termination reasons.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity by its ID.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Fetches an array of all TerminationReason entities ordered by name.
